name: Askara Halim
bio: Askara Halim is an Indonesian actor whose name is credited in the country's film industry. He is known for portraying Fino in Takkan Kubiarkan Kau Menangis (2026), a film produced by Langit Pictures Indonesia. Through his involvement in the project, he contributes to bringing the story and its characters to life on the big screen.

credits.title: Fatima
credits.overview: A dedicated Islamic exorcist navigating a barrage of terrifying supernatural disturbances must confront her deepest spiritual vulnerabilities when an ancient, malicious force threatens to destroy both her patients and her soul.

credits.title: Takkan Kubiarkan Kau Menangis
credits.overview: Dika felt like he was never enough for his mother, Dini, and their relationship was full of conflict. While pursuing his dreams with Sans Band and receiving guidance from Om Radit, Dika finally realized that beneath all his mother's demands lay genuine love and support.
